purpose: Prospective private zero-step CPU normal-gravity wall component. The current public parallel/tangential-gravity guards remain unchanged; this file is not evidence that normal-gravity walls are admitted.
seed: Reuse the retained zero-g upl_p3_wall_wave_seed_r3_h/CaseUplWall_h XML/BI4, or its already prepared Cubic copy. No GenCase, resampling or formal XML change. Require 1024 native soil IDs and 256 fixed native IDs, two x-normal FreeSlip faces, Z tangential periodicity, dp=1/512, width=height=1/16 and h/dp=1.8. Kernel can be Wendland or Cubic, selected by the genuine input and its CSP constants.
initialization: Actual LoadConfig/LoadCaseParticles/ConfigDomain/ConfigRunMode/InitRunCpu/FreePartsInit and InitDynamicPoreWallCpu run with the XML zero gravity. Only after this retained initialization does the private fixture assign Gravity and CSP.gravity=(+/-1,0,0). This bypass is explicit manufactured input, not a removed guard or a physical run.
manufacture: J=1, theta=0, p=128+rho_w*g dot x, rho_w=1000, true solid acceleration=0, finished Ace=-g, zero physical/derivative/tangent velocity and zero effective stress. All pressures stay below the old 256-Pa affine field scale and are exactly representable binary fractions. Four cases: +/-normal gravity, each coincident mirror targets and exact dp/8 target offsets. Offsets temporarily shift each inferred physical face by +/-dp/16; the true-face coordinates are evaluated explicitly, not replaced by the original face or the mirror target.
expected_production_change: ComputeDynamicPoreWallStateCpu must reconstruct p-rho_w*g dot x and restore +rho_w*g dot x at the actual boundary-sample position. The test does not implement this replacement locally. Existing ComputeDynamicPoreWallAccelerationCpu must supply Q*(Ace+g)-g. The unmodified even-pressure path is expected to fail its wall-pressure check; that failure is retained, not an invitation to loosen the budget.
actual_calls: Per case: PreInteraction_Forces; actual ComputeFreeSurfaceTracking (actual wall state, native C/free-surface classification and wall C); set native finished Ace=-g; actual wall acceleration; independent references; actual ComputeDynamicPorePressureRateCpu (which reconstructs wall acceleration again); PosInteraction_Forces. No Interaction_Forces_ct, Run, ComputeStep, main solver, time advance, restart or half-step is invoked.

checks.state: 1024 total fixed-native wall rows. Original affine base td=32768*DBL_EPSILON*condition and tf=64*FLT_EPSILON*condition, with condition=max(1,||M||inf*||M^-1||inf) from the actual kernel/J-weighted independent mirror support. p<=256tf, J<=2td, Ace<=tf; physical fixed velocity remains exactly zero with rho=RhopZero, derivative/tangent zero within tf, active mDBC mode. Every case's 18 native physical fields remain byte-unchanged; geometry/ID/normal bytes are restored.
checks.true_plane_flux: 256 total face rows, 32 genuine physical-face z locations on each of two faces per case. An independent all-slot weighted affine least-squares fit at the actual face uses current reconstructed wall plus fluid p and Darcy-Ace. It computes grad p, Ace and q_n=-(k/(rho_w*9.80665))*(grad p+rho_w*Ace) dot n. It does not substitute the analytic gradient into q. Prior affine td/tf are propagated through the MLS derivative: grad tolerance=tf*|rho_w*g|+256td/h, Ace tolerance=tf, hence normal-flux tolerance=k/gamma*(tf*(|rho_w*g|+rho_w)+256td/h). No Pa/mm physical acceptance threshold is introduced.
checks.negative_controls: Offline only, without mutating the production inputs: (1) replace boundary p by the old even value at its mirror target, omitting hydrostatic head restoration; (2) replace correct boundary Ace by Q*Ace, omitting the +g/-g terms. At each of all 256 physical-face probes each wrong q_n must exceed 100 times the unchanged good flux tolerance.
checks.complete_Darcy: 4096 total native receiver rows. Independent O(N^2) actual-slot enumeration, using actual current C/J/p/Ace, actual selected Wendland/Cubic radial Fac and constant-k full lp-grad(p) dot lx+rho_w*div(Ace) contraction. Compare actual complete production rate against this independent reference under the retained gravity-component limit (32*FLT_EPSILON+4096*DBL_EPSILON)*max(1,raw absolute-term rate). No interpolation/cell-search reuse, variable-k source or closed/open free-surface/drain modification. Rate values are recorded; an independent discrete comparison alone is not mechanical or time-integration accuracy.
checks.counts: Four cases, 1024 wall rows, 256 true-plane rows, 4096 full-rate rows, 1280 native identities in native_ids.csv. Fresh Run.out, twelve diagnostic CSVs, native_ids.csv and completion.json; no large native particle output.

execution_plan: Authoring only. Root must full-read source/note before compiling one new helper against current frozen non-main CPU Debug objects; do not run a historical wrapper. CLI: upl_gravity_wall_cpu_r1.exe --wall -cpu -ompthreads:1 -stable -mdbc_freeslip ABS_ZERO_G_SEED ABS_FRESH_RESULT. Each attempt needs a fresh result path; no automatic retry or overwriting failed evidence.
limits: Parallel x-normal FreeSlip only; tangential periodic support; constant J/k and prescribed zero true acceleration. No NoSlip, corner, unsupported/inactive wall, evolving J/n, force-stage gravity equilibrium, geostatic preparation, moving wall, plasticity, transient/full Darcy PDE, integrator, full-cycle or formal acceptance. This component is specifically preparation for reviewing a minimal pressure-head extension; it does not justify deleting public guards.
